stages.name: nodes
stages.query:
SELECT *,kind||':'||__start||':'||__end AS id,
 parent_kind||':'||parent_start||':'||parent_end AS parent,
 ancestor_kind||':'||ancestor_start||':'||ancestor_end AS edge_parent,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,parent_start,parent_end,parent_kind ORDER BY __start,__end,kind)-1 AS ordinal
 FROM (SELECT * FROM syntax_rows_0 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM syntax_rows_1)

stages.name: edges
stages.query: SELECT __path,edge_parent AS src,id AS dst,ordinal FROM nodes WHERE edge_parent IS NOT NULL

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='function_definition'

stages.name: ownership
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE owned(__path,id,fn,cls,top_fn) AS (
 SELECT n.__path,n.id,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='class_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END FROM nodes n
 LEFT JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=n.edge_parent WHERE parent.id IS NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT child.__path,child.id,CASE WHEN child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.fn END,CASE WHEN child.kind='class_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.cls END,CASE WHEN owned.top_fn IS NULL AND child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.top_fn END
 FROM owned JOIN edges e ON e.__path=owned.__path AND e.src=owned.id
 JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=e.__path AND child.id=e.dst) SELECT * FROM owned

stages.name: classes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='class_definition'

stages.name: methods
stages.query:
SELECT f.*,c.id AS cls,c.name AS class_name FROM functions f JOIN classes c ON c.__path=f.__path
 WHERE f.parent=c.body_kind||':'||c.body_start||':'||c.body_end OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes d WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.id=f.parent AND d.kind='decorated_definition' AND d.parent=c.body_kind||':'||c.body_start||':'||c.body_end)

stages.name: attributes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.attribute_source AS attr,n.object_kind||':'||n.object_start||':'||n.object_end AS object,n.object_source AS object_text FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='attribute'

stages.name: calls
stages.query: SELECT n.*,f.id AS callee_id,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.text AS full_callee,coalesce(a.attr,f.text) AS callee,a.object AS receiver FROM nodes n JOIN nodes f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.id=n.function_kind||':'||n.function_start||':'||n.function_end LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.id=f.id WHERE n.kind='call'

stages.name: arguments
stages.query: SELECT n.*,c.id AS call,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY c.__path,c.id ORDER BY n.__start)-1 AS position FROM calls c JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=c.__path AND n.parent=c.arguments_kind||':'||c.arguments_start||':'||c.arguments_end WHERE n.kind NOT IN ('comment','keyword_argument','list_splat','dictionary_splat')

stages.name: keywords
stages.query: SELECT c.__path,c.id AS call,k.id AS keyword,k.__start AS keyword_start,kn.text AS name,v.id AS value,v.__start,v.__end,v.text,v.kind FROM calls c JOIN nodes k ON k.__path=c.__path AND k.parent=c.arguments_kind||':'||c.arguments_start||':'||c.arguments_end AND k.kind='keyword_argument' JOIN nodes kn ON kn.__path=k.__path AND kn.id=k.name_kind||':'||k.name_start||':'||k.name_end JOIN nodes v ON v.__path=k.__path AND v.id=k.value_kind||':'||k.value_start||':'||k.value_end

stages.name: descendants
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE walk(__path,root,node) AS (SELECT __path,id,id FROM nodes UNION SELECT w.__path,w.root,e.dst FROM walk w JOIN edges e ON e.__path=w.__path AND e.src=w.node) SELECT * FROM walk

stages.name: returns
stages.query: SELECT n.*,v.id AS value,v.kind AS expr_kind,v.text AS expr_text,o.fn FROM nodes n JOIN nodes v ON v.__path=n.__path AND v.parent=n.id LEFT JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id WHERE n.kind='return_statement'

stages.name: assignments
stages.query: SELECT n.*,l.id AS target,l.kind AS target_kind,l.text AS target_text,r.id AS value,r.kind AS expr_kind,r.text AS expr_text,o.fn FROM nodes n JOIN nodes l ON l.__path=n.__path AND l.id=n.left_kind||':'||n.left_start||':'||n.left_end LEFT JOIN nodes r ON r.__path=n.__path AND r.id=n.right_kind||':'||n.right_start||':'||n.right_end LEFT JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id WHERE n.kind='assignment'

stages.name: files
stages.query: SELECT p.__path,p.text AS source,(p.__path IN ('api/l2070_batching/executor.py','impl/common/l2070_server_plan/base_server_plan.py','impl/common/l2070_server_plan/plan_helpers.py','impl/common/l2070_server_plan/sql_backend_executor.py','l2070_batching/conditional_step.py') OR p.__path IN ('impl/common/l2070_server_plan/base_server_plan.py','impl/common/l2070_server_plan/plan_helpers.py','impl/common/l2070_server_plan/steps/tests/test_conditional_compile_dialects.py','l2070_batching/compilation.py','l2070_batching/optimizer.py','l2070_batching/plan_prerequisites.py') OR NOT rx_matches(p.__path,'(?:^|/)__init__\.py$') AND (substr(p.__path,1,36)='impl/common/l2070_server_plan/steps/' OR substr(p.__path,1,51)='impl/common/l7300_sql_versioned_transactions/steps/' OR substr(p.__path,1,40)='impl/common/l9700_sql_graph_query/steps/' OR substr(p.__path,1,41)='impl/common/l2070_server_plan/strategies/' OR rx_matches(p.__path,'^impl/common/l2070_server_plan/[^/]+$'))) AS primary_file,(NOT rx_matches(p.__path,'(?:^|/)__init__\.py$') AND (substr(p.__path,1,14)='l9750_graphql/' OR substr(p.__path,1,15)='l2080_lazy_orm/' OR substr(p.__path,1,20)='l2060_query_builder/' OR substr(p.__path,1,15)='l9900_auto_api/')) AS fallback_file,(NOT rx_matches(p.__path,'(?:^|/)__init__\.py$') AND rx_matches(p.__path,'^(?:impl|l[0-9]{4}_[^/]+)/')) AS callback_file FROM nodes p WHERE kind='module'

stages.name: base_names
stages.query: SELECT c.__path,c.id AS cls,coalesce(rx_extract(b.text,'(?:^|\.)([A-Za-z_]\w*)(?:\[.*\])?$',1),b.text) AS name FROM classes c JOIN nodes args ON args.__path=c.__path AND args.parent=c.id AND args.kind='argument_list' JOIN nodes b ON b.__path=args.__path AND b.parent=args.id WHERE b.kind!='keyword_argument'

stages.name: method_nodes
stages.query: SELECT m.__path,m.id AS method,m.cls,m.name AS method_name,m.class_name,d.node FROM methods m JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=m.__path AND d.root=m.id

stages.name: import_ranges
stages.query: SELECT __path,__start,__end FROM nodes WHERE kind IN ('import_statement','import_from_statement')

stages.name: import_identifiers
stages.query: SELECT n.__path,n.id FROM import_ranges imp JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=imp.__path AND n.__start>=imp.__start AND n.__start<=imp.__end WHERE n.kind='identifier' AND n.__end<=imp.__end

stages.name: py_names
stages.query: SELECT n.* FROM nodes n JOIN nodes p ON p.__path=n.__path AND p.id=n.parent WHERE n.kind='identifier' AND NOT (p.kind IN ('function_definition','class_definition','keyword_argument') AND n.__start=p.name_start) AND NOT (p.kind='attribute' AND n.__start=p.attribute_start) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM import_identifiers imp WHERE imp.__path=n.__path AND imp.id=n.id)

stages.name: class_levels
stages.query: SELECT __path,cls,CAST(text AS INTEGER) AS level FROM (SELECT mn.__path,mn.cls,n.text,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY mn.__path,mn.cls ORDER BY n.__start) AS chosen FROM method_nodes mn JOIN returns r ON r.__path=mn.__path AND r.id=mn.node JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=r.__path AND n.id=r.value AND n.kind='integer' WHERE mn.method_name='level') WHERE chosen=1

stages.name: statements
stages.query: SELECT f.__path,f.id AS fn,s.id,s.kind,s.__start,s.__end FROM functions f JOIN nodes s ON s.__path=f.__path AND s.parent=f.body_kind||':'||f.body_start||':'||f.body_end WHERE s.kind!='comment' AND NOT (s.kind='expression_statement' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes value WHERE value.__path=s.__path AND value.parent=s.id AND value.kind IN ('string','concatenated_string','integer','float','true','false','none')))

stages.name: literal_bools
stages.query: SELECT f.__path,f.id AS fn,v.kind AS value FROM functions f JOIN statements s ON s.__path=f.__path AND s.fn=f.id JOIN nodes v ON v.__path=s.__path AND v.parent=s.id AND v.kind IN ('true','false') WHERE s.kind='return_statement' AND (SELECT count(*) FROM statements other WHERE other.__path=f.__path AND other.fn=f.id)=1

stages.name: module_functions
stages.query: SELECT f.* FROM functions f WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes p WHERE p.__path=f.__path AND p.id=f.parent AND (p.kind='module' OR p.kind='decorated_definition' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes root WHERE root.__path=p.__path AND root.id=p.parent AND root.kind='module')))

stages.name: abstract_functions
stages.query: SELECT f.__path,f.id FROM functions f WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes wrapper JOIN nodes decorator ON decorator.__path=wrapper.__path AND decorator.parent=wrapper.id AND decorator.kind='decorator' JOIN nodes value ON value.__path=decorator.__path AND value.parent=decorator.id WHERE wrapper.__path=f.__path AND wrapper.id=f.parent AND value.kind IN ('identifier','attribute') AND rx_matches(value.text,'(?:^|\.)abstractmethod$')) OR (SELECT count(*) FROM statements s WHERE s.__path=f.__path AND s.fn=f.id)=1 AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM statements s WHERE s.__path=f.__path AND s.fn=f.id AND s.kind='pass_statement')

stages.name: last_methods
stages.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT *,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,cls,name ORDER BY __start DESC) AS chosen FROM methods) WHERE chosen=1

stages.name: last_module_functions
stages.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT *,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,name ORDER BY __start DESC) AS chosen FROM module_functions) WHERE chosen=1

stages.name: nodes
stages.query:
SELECT *,kind||':'||__start||':'||__end AS id,
 parent_kind||':'||parent_start||':'||parent_end AS parent,
 ancestor_kind||':'||ancestor_start||':'||ancestor_end AS edge_parent,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,parent_start,parent_end,parent_kind ORDER BY __start,__end,kind)-1 AS ordinal
 FROM (SELECT * FROM syntax_rows_0 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM syntax_rows_1)

stages.name: edges
stages.query: SELECT __path,edge_parent AS src,id AS dst,ordinal FROM nodes WHERE edge_parent IS NOT NULL

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='function_definition'

stages.name: ownership
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE owned(__path,id,fn,cls,top_fn) AS (
 SELECT n.__path,n.id,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='class_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END FROM nodes n
 LEFT JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=n.edge_parent WHERE parent.id IS NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT child.__path,child.id,CASE WHEN child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.fn END,CASE WHEN child.kind='class_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.cls END,CASE WHEN owned.top_fn IS NULL AND child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.top_fn END
 FROM owned JOIN edges e ON e.__path=owned.__path AND e.src=owned.id
 JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=e.__path AND child.id=e.dst) SELECT * FROM owned

stages.name: classes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='class_definition'

stages.name: attributes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.attribute_source AS attr,n.object_kind||':'||n.object_start||':'||n.object_end AS object,n.object_source AS object_text FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='attribute'

stages.name: calls
stages.query: SELECT n.*,f.id AS callee_id,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.text AS full_callee,coalesce(a.attr,f.text) AS callee,a.object AS receiver FROM nodes n JOIN nodes f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.id=n.function_kind||':'||n.function_start||':'||n.function_end LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.id=f.id WHERE n.kind='call'

stages.name: keywords
stages.query: SELECT c.__path,c.id AS call,k.id AS keyword,k.__start AS keyword_start,kn.text AS name,v.id AS value,v.__start,v.__end,v.text,v.kind FROM calls c JOIN nodes k ON k.__path=c.__path AND k.parent=c.arguments_kind||':'||c.arguments_start||':'||c.arguments_end AND k.kind='keyword_argument' JOIN nodes kn ON kn.__path=k.__path AND kn.id=k.name_kind||':'||k.name_start||':'||k.name_end JOIN nodes v ON v.__path=k.__path AND v.id=k.value_kind||':'||k.value_start||':'||k.value_end

stages.name: assignments
stages.query: SELECT n.*,l.id AS target,l.kind AS target_kind,l.text AS target_text,r.id AS value,r.kind AS expr_kind,r.text AS expr_text,o.fn FROM nodes n JOIN nodes l ON l.__path=n.__path AND l.id=n.left_kind||':'||n.left_start||':'||n.left_end LEFT JOIN nodes r ON r.__path=n.__path AND r.id=n.right_kind||':'||n.right_start||':'||n.right_end LEFT JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id WHERE n.kind='assignment'

stages.name: files
stages.query: SELECT p.__path,p.text AS source,(p.__path IN ('api/l2070_batching/executor.py','impl/common/l2070_server_plan/base_server_plan.py','impl/common/l2070_server_plan/plan_helpers.py','impl/common/l2070_server_plan/sql_backend_executor.py','l2070_batching/conditional_step.py') OR p.__path IN ('impl/common/l2070_server_plan/base_server_plan.py','impl/common/l2070_server_plan/plan_helpers.py','impl/common/l2070_server_plan/steps/tests/test_conditional_compile_dialects.py','l2070_batching/compilation.py','l2070_batching/optimizer.py','l2070_batching/plan_prerequisites.py') OR NOT rx_matches(p.__path,'(?:^|/)__init__\.py$') AND (substr(p.__path,1,36)='impl/common/l2070_server_plan/steps/' OR substr(p.__path,1,51)='impl/common/l7300_sql_versioned_transactions/steps/' OR substr(p.__path,1,40)='impl/common/l9700_sql_graph_query/steps/' OR substr(p.__path,1,41)='impl/common/l2070_server_plan/strategies/' OR rx_matches(p.__path,'^impl/common/l2070_server_plan/[^/]+$'))) AS primary_file,(NOT rx_matches(p.__path,'(?:^|/)__init__\.py$') AND (substr(p.__path,1,14)='l9750_graphql/' OR substr(p.__path,1,15)='l2080_lazy_orm/' OR substr(p.__path,1,20)='l2060_query_builder/' OR substr(p.__path,1,15)='l9900_auto_api/')) AS fallback_file,(NOT rx_matches(p.__path,'(?:^|/)__init__\.py$') AND rx_matches(p.__path,'^(?:impl|l[0-9]{4}_[^/]+)/')) AS callback_file FROM nodes p WHERE kind='module'

stages.name: base_names
stages.query: SELECT c.__path,c.id AS cls,coalesce(rx_extract(b.text,'(?:^|\.)([A-Za-z_]\w*)(?:\[.*\])?$',1),b.text) AS name FROM classes c JOIN nodes args ON args.__path=c.__path AND args.parent=c.id AND args.kind='argument_list' JOIN nodes b ON b.__path=args.__path AND b.parent=args.id WHERE b.kind!='keyword_argument'

stages.name: import_ranges
stages.query: SELECT __path,__start,__end FROM nodes WHERE kind IN ('import_statement','import_from_statement')

stages.name: import_identifiers
stages.query: SELECT n.__path,n.id FROM import_ranges imp JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=imp.__path AND n.__start>=imp.__start AND n.__start<=imp.__end WHERE n.kind='identifier' AND n.__end<=imp.__end

stages.name: py_names
stages.query: SELECT n.* FROM nodes n JOIN nodes p ON p.__path=n.__path AND p.id=n.parent WHERE n.kind='identifier' AND NOT (p.kind IN ('function_definition','class_definition','keyword_argument') AND n.__start=p.name_start) AND NOT (p.kind='attribute' AND n.__start=p.attribute_start) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM import_identifiers imp WHERE imp.__path=n.__path AND imp.id=n.id)

stages.name: ownership
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE owned(__path,id,fn,cls,top_fn) AS (
 SELECT n.__path,n.id,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='class_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END FROM nodes n
 LEFT JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=n.edge_parent WHERE parent.id IS NULL

stages.name: methods

stages.name: arguments

stages.name: nodes
stages.query:
SELECT *,kind||':'||__start||':'||__end AS id,
 parent_kind||':'||parent_start||':'||parent_end AS parent,
 ancestor_kind||':'||ancestor_start||':'||ancestor_end AS edge_parent,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,parent_start,parent_end,parent_kind ORDER BY __start,__end,kind)-1 AS ordinal
 FROM (SELECT * FROM syntax_rows_0 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM syntax_rows_1)

stages.name: edges
stages.query: SELECT __path,edge_parent AS src,id AS dst,ordinal FROM nodes WHERE edge_parent IS NOT NULL

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='function_definition'

stages.name: classes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='class_definition'

stages.name: methods
stages.query:
SELECT f.*,c.id AS cls,c.name AS class_name FROM functions f JOIN classes c ON c.__path=f.__path
 WHERE f.parent=c.body_kind||':'||c.body_start||':'||c.body_end OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes d WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.id=f.parent AND d.kind='decorated_definition' AND d.parent=c.body_kind||':'||c.body_start||':'||c.body_end)

stages.name: attributes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.attribute_source AS attr,n.object_kind||':'||n.object_start||':'||n.object_end AS object,n.object_source AS object_text FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='attribute'

stages.name: calls
stages.query: SELECT n.*,f.id AS callee_id,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.text AS full_callee,coalesce(a.attr,f.text) AS callee,a.object AS receiver FROM nodes n JOIN nodes f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.id=n.function_kind||':'||n.function_start||':'||n.function_end LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.id=f.id WHERE n.kind='call'

stages.name: arguments
stages.query: SELECT n.*,c.id AS call,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY c.__path,c.id ORDER BY n.__start)-1 AS position FROM calls c JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=c.__path AND n.parent=c.arguments_kind||':'||c.arguments_start||':'||c.arguments_end WHERE n.kind NOT IN ('comment','keyword_argument','list_splat','dictionary_splat')

stages.name: keywords
stages.query: SELECT c.__path,c.id AS call,k.id AS keyword,k.__start AS keyword_start,kn.text AS name,v.id AS value,v.__start,v.__end,v.text,v.kind FROM calls c JOIN nodes k ON k.__path=c.__path AND k.parent=c.arguments_kind||':'||c.arguments_start||':'||c.arguments_end AND k.kind='keyword_argument' JOIN nodes kn ON kn.__path=k.__path AND kn.id=k.name_kind||':'||k.name_start||':'||k.name_end JOIN nodes v ON v.__path=k.__path AND v.id=k.value_kind||':'||k.value_start||':'||k.value_end

stages.name: descendants
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE walk(__path,root,node) AS (SELECT __path,id,id FROM nodes UNION SELECT w.__path,w.root,e.dst FROM walk w JOIN edges e ON e.__path=w.__path AND e.src=w.node) SELECT * FROM walk

stages.name: base_names
stages.query: SELECT c.__path,c.id AS cls,coalesce(rx_extract(b.text,'(?:^|\.)([A-Za-z_]\w*)(?:\[.*\])?$',1),b.text) AS name FROM classes c JOIN nodes args ON args.__path=c.__path AND args.parent=c.id AND args.kind='argument_list' JOIN nodes b ON b.__path=args.__path AND b.parent=args.id WHERE b.kind!='keyword_argument'

stages.name: method_nodes
stages.query: SELECT m.__path,m.id AS method,m.cls,m.name AS method_name,m.class_name,d.node FROM methods m JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=m.__path AND d.root=m.id

stages.name: import_ranges
stages.query: SELECT __path,__start,__end FROM nodes WHERE kind IN ('import_statement','import_from_statement')

stages.name: import_identifiers
stages.query: SELECT n.__path,n.id FROM import_ranges imp JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=imp.__path AND n.__start>=imp.__start AND n.__start<=imp.__end WHERE n.kind='identifier' AND n.__end<=imp.__end

stages.name: py_names
stages.query: SELECT n.* FROM nodes n JOIN nodes p ON p.__path=n.__path AND p.id=n.parent WHERE n.kind='identifier' AND NOT (p.kind IN ('function_definition','class_definition','keyword_argument') AND n.__start=p.name_start) AND NOT (p.kind='attribute' AND n.__start=p.attribute_start) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM import_identifiers imp WHERE imp.__path=n.__path AND imp.id=n.id)

stages.name: statements
stages.query: SELECT f.__path,f.id AS fn,s.id,s.kind,s.__start,s.__end FROM functions f JOIN nodes s ON s.__path=f.__path AND s.parent=f.body_kind||':'||f.body_start||':'||f.body_end WHERE s.kind!='comment' AND NOT (s.kind='expression_statement' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes value WHERE value.__path=s.__path AND value.parent=s.id AND value.kind IN ('string','concatenated_string','integer','float','true','false','none')))

stages.name: literal_bools
stages.query: SELECT f.__path,f.id AS fn,v.kind AS value FROM functions f JOIN statements s ON s.__path=f.__path AND s.fn=f.id JOIN nodes v ON v.__path=s.__path AND v.parent=s.id AND v.kind IN ('true','false') WHERE s.kind='return_statement' AND (SELECT count(*) FROM statements other WHERE other.__path=f.__path AND other.fn=f.id)=1

stages.name: strings
stages.query: SELECT * FROM raw_strings UNION SELECT * FROM raw_fstring_parts

stages.query: SELECT n.*,c.id AS call,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY c.__path,c.id ORDER BY n.__start)-1 AS position FROM calls c JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=c.__path AND n.parent=c.arguments_kind||':'||c.arguments_start||':'||c.arguments_end WHERE n.kind NOT IN ('comment','keyword_argument','list_splat','dictionary_splat')

stages.name: keywords
stages.query: SELECT c.__path,c.id AS call,k.id AS keyword,k.__start AS keyword_start,kn.text AS name,v.id AS value,v.__start,v.__end,v.text,v.kind FROM calls c JOIN nodes k ON k.__path=c.__path AND k.parent=c.arguments_kind||':'||c.arguments_start||':'||c.arguments_end AND k.kind='keyword_argument' JOIN nodes kn ON kn.__path=k.__path AND kn.id=k.name_kind||':'||k.name_start||':'||k.name_end JOIN nodes v ON v.__path=k.__path AND v.id=k.value_kind||':'||k.value_start||':'||k.value_end

stages.name: descendants
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE walk(__path,root,node) AS (SELECT __path,id,id FROM nodes UNION SELECT w.__path,w.root,e.dst FROM walk w JOIN edges e ON e.__path=w.__path AND e.src=w.node) SELECT * FROM walk

stages.name: files
stages.query: SELECT p.__path,p.text AS source,(p.__path IN ('api/l2070_batching/executor.py','impl/common/l2070_server_plan/base_server_plan.py','impl/common/l2070_server_plan/plan_helpers.py','impl/common/l2070_server_plan/sql_backend_executor.py','l2070_batching/conditional_step.py') OR p.__path IN ('impl/common/l2070_server_plan/base_server_plan.py','impl/common/l2070_server_plan/plan_helpers.py','impl/common/l2070_server_plan/steps/tests/test_conditional_compile_dialects.py','l2070_batching/compilation.py','l2070_batching/optimizer.py','l2070_batching/plan_prerequisites.py') OR NOT rx_matches(p.__path,'(?:^|/)__init__\.py$') AND (substr(p.__path,1,36)='impl/common/l2070_server_plan/steps/' OR substr(p.__path,1,51)='impl/common/l7300_sql_versioned_transactions/steps/' OR substr(p.__path,1,40)='impl/common/l9700_sql_graph_query/steps/' OR substr(p.__path,1,41)='impl/common/l2070_server_plan/strategies/' OR rx_matches(p.__path,'^impl/common/l2070_server_plan/[^/]+$'))) AS primary_file,(NOT rx_matches(p.__path,'(?:^|/)__init__\.py$') AND (substr(p.__path,1,14)='l9750_graphql/' OR substr(p.__path,1,15)='l2080_lazy_orm/' OR substr(p.__path,1,20)='l2060_query_builder/' OR substr(p.__path,1,15)='l9900_auto_api/')) AS fallback_file,(NOT rx_matches(p.__path,'(?:^|/)__init__\.py$') AND rx_matches(p.__path,'^(?:impl|l[0-9]{4}_[^/]+)/')) AS callback_file FROM nodes p WHERE kind='module'

stages.name: import_ranges
stages.query: SELECT __path,__start,__end FROM nodes WHERE kind IN ('import_statement','import_from_statement')

stages.name: import_identifiers
stages.query: SELECT n.__path,n.id FROM import_ranges imp JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=imp.__path AND n.__start>=imp.__start AND n.__start<=imp.__end WHERE n.kind='identifier' AND n.__end<=imp.__end

stages.name: py_names
stages.query: SELECT n.* FROM nodes n JOIN nodes p ON p.__path=n.__path AND p.id=n.parent WHERE n.kind='identifier' AND NOT (p.kind IN ('function_definition','class_definition','keyword_argument') AND n.__start=p.name_start) AND NOT (p.kind='attribute' AND n.__start=p.attribute_start) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM import_identifiers imp WHERE imp.__path=n.__path AND imp.id=n.id)

stages.name: strings
stages.query: SELECT * FROM raw_strings UNION SELECT * FROM raw_fstring_parts

stages.name: scoped_nodes
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE walk(__path,fn,node) AS (SELECT __path,id,id FROM functions UNION ALL SELECT w.__path,w.fn,n.id FROM walk w JOIN edges e ON e.__path=w.__path AND e.src=w.node JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=e.__path AND n.id=e.dst WHERE n.kind NOT IN ('function_definition','class_definition','lambda')) SELECT * FROM walk

stages.name: loop_names
stages.query: SELECT s.__path,s.fn,CASE WHEN loop.kind='for_in_clause' THEN loop.parent ELSE loop.id END AS loop,name.text AS name FROM scoped_nodes s JOIN nodes loop ON loop.__path=s.__path AND loop.id=s.node AND loop.kind IN ('for_statement','for_in_clause') JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=loop.__path AND d.root=loop.left_kind||':'||loop.left_start||':'||loop.left_end JOIN py_names name ON name.__path=d.__path AND name.id=d.node

stages.name: projection_repairs
stages.query: SELECT DISTINCT names.__path,names.fn FROM loop_names names JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=names.__path AND d.root=names.loop JOIN calls c ON c.__path=d.__path AND c.id=d.node WHERE (c.full_callee='dict' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arguments arg JOIN descendants refs ON refs.__path=arg.__path AND refs.root=arg.id JOIN py_names n ON n.__path=refs.__path AND n.id=refs.node AND n.text=names.name WHERE arg.__path=c.__path AND arg.call=c.id)) OR (c.callee_kind='attribute' AND c.callee IN ('dict','model_dump') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants refs JOIN py_names n ON n.__path=refs.__path AND n.id=refs.node AND n.text=names.name WHERE refs.__path=c.__path AND refs.root=c.receiver))

stages.name: path_edges
stages.query: SELECT __path,object AS src,id AS dst,'.'||attr AS suffix FROM attributes UNION SELECT __path,callee_id,id,'' FROM calls

stages.name: call_paths
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE names(__path,id,path) AS (SELECT __path,id,text FROM py_names UNION SELECT n.__path,e.dst,n.path||e.suffix FROM names n JOIN path_edges e ON e.__path=n.__path AND e.src=n.id) SELECT * FROM names

stages.name: execution_calls
stages.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT c.__path,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,CASE WHEN c.callee IN ('_add_intent','_add_intent_by_ref','_get_lazy_plan','enqueue_lazy_plan_intent','execute_later','return_result') OR rx_matches(paths.path,'(?:^|\.)(?:ServerPlan|BaseServerPlan|[A-Za-z_]\w*Intent)(?:\.|$)') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS build,CASE WHEN c.callee IN ('execute','execute_async','graph','graph_async','load_with_includes','load_with_includes_async','query','query_async') AND (c.callee LIKE 'load_with_includes%' OR rx_matches(paths.path,'(?:^|\.)(?:txn|tx|vrtxn|conn|query)\.[^.]+$')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS direct FROM calls c JOIN call_paths paths ON paths.__path=c.__path AND paths.id=c.callee_id) WHERE build OR direct

stages.name: branches
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.consequence_kind||':'||n.consequence_start||':'||n.consequence_end AS then_block,(SELECT min(alt.__start) FROM nodes alt WHERE alt.__path=n.__path AND alt.parent=CASE WHEN n.kind='if_statement' THEN n.id ELSE n.parent END AND alt.kind IN ('else_clause','elif_clause') AND alt.__start>n.__start) AS else_start,(SELECT max(alt.__end) FROM nodes alt WHERE alt.__path=n.__path AND alt.parent=CASE WHEN n.kind='if_statement' THEN n.id ELSE n.parent END AND alt.kind IN ('else_clause','elif_clause') AND alt.__start>n.__start) AS else_end FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind IN ('if_statement','elif_clause')

stages.name: branch_flags
stages.query: SELECT b.*,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants d CROSS JOIN execution_calls c ON c.__path=d.__path AND c.id=d.node AND c.build WHERE d.__path=b.__path AND d.root=b.then_block) AS then_build,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants d CROSS JOIN execution_calls c ON c.__path=d.__path AND c.id=d.node AND c.direct WHERE d.__path=b.__path AND d.root=b.then_block) AS then_direct,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM execution_calls c WHERE c.__path=b.__path AND c.build AND c.__start>=b.else_start AND c.__end<=b.else_end) AS else_build,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM execution_calls c WHERE c.__path=b.__path AND c.direct AND c.__start>=b.else_start AND c.__end<=b.else_end) AS else_direct FROM branches b

WITH RECURSIVE owned(__path,id,fn,cls,top_fn) AS (
 SELECT n.__path,n.id,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='class_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END FROM nodes n
 LEFT JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=n.edge_parent WHERE parent.id IS NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT child.__path,child.id,CASE WHEN child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.fn END,CASE WHEN child.kind='class_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.cls END,CASE WHEN owned.top_fn IS NULL AND child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.top_fn END

 JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=e.__path AND child.id=e.dst) SELECT * FROM owned

stages.name: syntax_rows_1
stages.query: SELECT __path,__start,__end,kind,text,line,parent_start,parent_end,parent_kind,ancestor_start,ancestor_end,ancestor_kind,name_start,name_source,function_start,function_end,function_kind,object_start,object_end,object_kind,object_source,attribute_start,attribute_source,condition_start,condition_end,condition_kind,consequence_start,consequence_end,consequence_kind FROM syntax_24

stages.name: nodes
stages.query:
SELECT *,kind||':'||__start||':'||__end AS id,
 parent_kind||':'||parent_start||':'||parent_end AS parent,
 ancestor_kind||':'||ancestor_start||':'||ancestor_end AS edge_parent,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,parent_start,parent_end,parent_kind ORDER BY __start,__end,kind)-1 AS ordinal
 FROM (SELECT * FROM syntax_rows_0 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM syntax_rows_1)

stages.name: edges
stages.query: SELECT __path,edge_parent AS src,id AS dst,ordinal FROM nodes WHERE edge_parent IS NOT NULL

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='function_definition'

stages.name: attributes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.attribute_source AS attr,n.object_kind||':'||n.object_start||':'||n.object_end AS object,n.object_source AS object_text FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='attribute'

stages.name: calls
stages.query: SELECT n.*,f.id AS callee_id,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.text AS full_callee,coalesce(a.attr,f.text) AS callee,a.object AS receiver FROM nodes n JOIN nodes f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.id=n.function_kind||':'||n.function_start||':'||n.function_end LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.id=f.id WHERE n.kind='call'

stages.name: descendants
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE walk(__path,root,node) AS (SELECT __path,id,id FROM nodes UNION SELECT w.__path,w.root,e.dst FROM walk w JOIN edges e ON e.__path=w.__path AND e.src=w.node) SELECT * FROM walk

stages.name: files
stages.query: SELECT p.__path,p.text AS source,(p.__path IN ('api/l2070_batching/executor.py','impl/common/l2070_server_plan/base_server_plan.py','impl/common/l2070_server_plan/plan_helpers.py','impl/common/l2070_server_plan/sql_backend_executor.py','l2070_batching/conditional_step.py') OR p.__path IN ('impl/common/l2070_server_plan/base_server_plan.py','impl/common/l2070_server_plan/plan_helpers.py','impl/common/l2070_server_plan/steps/tests/test_conditional_compile_dialects.py','l2070_batching/compilation.py','l2070_batching/optimizer.py','l2070_batching/plan_prerequisites.py') OR NOT rx_matches(p.__path,'(?:^|/)__init__\.py$') AND (substr(p.__path,1,36)='impl/common/l2070_server_plan/steps/' OR substr(p.__path,1,51)='impl/common/l7300_sql_versioned_transactions/steps/' OR substr(p.__path,1,40)='impl/common/l9700_sql_graph_query/steps/' OR substr(p.__path,1,41)='impl/common/l2070_server_plan/strategies/' OR rx_matches(p.__path,'^impl/common/l2070_server_plan/[^/]+$'))) AS primary_file,(NOT rx_matches(p.__path,'(?:^|/)__init__\.py$') AND (substr(p.__path,1,14)='l9750_graphql/' OR substr(p.__path,1,15)='l2080_lazy_orm/' OR substr(p.__path,1,20)='l2060_query_builder/' OR substr(p.__path,1,15)='l9900_auto_api/')) AS fallback_file,(NOT rx_matches(p.__path,'(?:^|/)__init__\.py$') AND rx_matches(p.__path,'^(?:impl|l[0-9]{4}_[^/]+)/')) AS callback_file FROM nodes p WHERE kind='module'

stages.name: import_ranges
stages.query: SELECT __path,__start,__end FROM nodes WHERE kind IN ('import_statement','import_from_statement')

stages.name: import_identifiers
stages.query: SELECT n.__path,n.id FROM import_ranges imp JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=imp.__path AND n.__start>=imp.__start AND n.__start<=imp.__end WHERE n.kind='identifier' AND n.__end<=imp.__end

stages.name: py_names
stages.query: SELECT n.* FROM nodes n JOIN nodes p ON p.__path=n.__path AND p.id=n.parent WHERE n.kind='identifier' AND NOT (p.kind IN ('function_definition','class_definition','keyword_argument') AND n.__start=p.name_start) AND NOT (p.kind='attribute' AND n.__start=p.attribute_start) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM import_identifiers imp WHERE imp.__path=n.__path AND imp.id=n.id)

stages.name: strings
stages.query: SELECT * FROM raw_strings UNION SELECT * FROM raw_fstring_parts

stages.name: path_edges
stages.query: SELECT __path,object AS src,id AS dst,'.'||attr AS suffix FROM attributes UNION SELECT __path,callee_id,id,'' FROM calls

stages.name: call_paths
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE names(__path,id,path) AS (SELECT __path,id,text FROM py_names UNION SELECT n.__path,e.dst,n.path||e.suffix FROM names n JOIN path_edges e ON e.__path=n.__path AND e.src=n.id) SELECT * FROM names

stages.name: execution_calls
stages.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT c.__path,c.id,c.__start,c.__end,CASE WHEN c.callee IN ('_add_intent','_add_intent_by_ref','_get_lazy_plan','enqueue_lazy_plan_intent','execute_later','return_result') OR rx_matches(paths.path,'(?:^|\.)(?:ServerPlan|BaseServerPlan|[A-Za-z_]\w*Intent)(?:\.|$)') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS build,CASE WHEN c.callee IN ('execute','execute_async','graph','graph_async','load_with_includes','load_with_includes_async','query','query_async') AND (c.callee LIKE 'load_with_includes%' OR rx_matches(paths.path,'(?:^|\.)(?:txn|tx|vrtxn|conn|query)\.[^.]+$')) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS direct FROM calls c JOIN call_paths paths ON paths.__path=c.__path AND paths.id=c.callee_id) WHERE build OR direct

stages.name: branches
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.consequence_kind||':'||n.consequence_start||':'||n.consequence_end AS then_block,(SELECT min(alt.__start) FROM nodes alt WHERE alt.__path=n.__path AND alt.parent=CASE WHEN n.kind='if_statement' THEN n.id ELSE n.parent END AND alt.kind IN ('else_clause','elif_clause') AND alt.__start>n.__start) AS else_start,(SELECT max(alt.__end) FROM nodes alt WHERE alt.__path=n.__path AND alt.parent=CASE WHEN n.kind='if_statement' THEN n.id ELSE n.parent END AND alt.kind IN ('else_clause','elif_clause') AND alt.__start>n.__start) AS else_end FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind IN ('if_statement','elif_clause')

stages.name: branch_flags
stages.query: SELECT b.*,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants d CROSS JOIN execution_calls c ON c.__path=d.__path AND c.id=d.node AND c.build WHERE d.__path=b.__path AND d.root=b.then_block) AS then_build,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants d CROSS JOIN execution_calls c ON c.__path=d.__path AND c.id=d.node AND c.direct WHERE d.__path=b.__path AND d.root=b.then_block) AS then_direct,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM execution_calls c WHERE c.__path=b.__path AND c.build AND c.__start>=b.else_start AND c.__end<=b.else_end) AS else_build,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM execution_calls c WHERE c.__path=b.__path AND c.direct AND c.__start>=b.else_start AND c.__end<=b.else_end) AS else_direct FROM branches b

stages.name: through_conditions
stages.query:
SELECT DISTINCT cmp.__path,cmp.id FROM nodes cmp JOIN nodes operand ON operand.__path=cmp.__path AND operand.parent=cmp.id AND operand.kind!='comment' JOIN nodes previous ON previous.__path=operand.__path AND previous.parent=cmp.id AND previous.kind!='comment' AND previous.__start<operand.__start
 WHERE cmp.kind='comparison_operator' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes between_operand WHERE between_operand.__path=operand.__path AND between_operand.parent=cmp.id AND between_operand.kind!='comment' AND between_operand.__start>previous.__start AND between_operand.__start<operand.__start)
 AND ((trim(CAST(substr(CAST(cmp.text AS BLOB),previous.__end-cmp.__start+1,operand.__start-previous.__end) AS TEXT)) IN ('==','!=') AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants d JOIN nodes literal ON literal.__path=d.__path AND literal.id=d.node JOIN strings s ON s.__path=literal.__path AND s.__start=literal.__start AND s.__end=literal.__end WHERE d.__path=operand.__path AND d.root=operand.id AND s.value='through'))
 OR (trim(CAST(substr(CAST(cmp.text AS BLOB),previous.__end-cmp.__start+1,operand.__start-previous.__end) AS TEXT)) IN ('in','not in') AND operand.kind IN ('set','list','tuple') AND (SELECT count(*) FROM nodes el JOIN strings s ON s.__path=el.__path AND s.__start=el.__start AND s.__end=el.__end WHERE el.__path=operand.__path AND el.parent=operand.id AND s.value='through')=1 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes el WHERE el.__path=operand.__path AND el.parent=operand.id AND el.kind IN ('integer','float','true','false','none')) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes el JOIN strings s ON s.__path=el.__path AND s.__start=el.__start AND s.__end=el.__end WHERE el.__path=operand.__path AND el.parent=operand.id AND s.value!='through')))

stages.name: nodes
stages.query:
SELECT *,kind||':'||__start||':'||__end AS id,
 parent_kind||':'||parent_start||':'||parent_end AS parent,
 ancestor_kind||':'||ancestor_start||':'||ancestor_end AS edge_parent,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,parent_start,parent_end,parent_kind ORDER BY __start,__end,kind)-1 AS ordinal
 FROM (SELECT * FROM syntax_rows_0 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM syntax_rows_1)

stages.name: edges
stages.query: SELECT __path,edge_parent AS src,id AS dst,ordinal FROM nodes WHERE edge_parent IS NOT NULL

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='function_definition'

stages.name: ownership
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE owned(__path,id,fn,cls,top_fn) AS (
 SELECT n.__path,n.id,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='class_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END FROM nodes n
 LEFT JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=n.edge_parent WHERE parent.id IS NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT child.__path,child.id,CASE WHEN child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.fn END,CASE WHEN child.kind='class_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.cls END,CASE WHEN owned.top_fn IS NULL AND child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.top_fn END
 FROM owned JOIN edges e ON e.__path=owned.__path AND e.src=owned.id
 JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=e.__path AND child.id=e.dst) SELECT * FROM owned

stages.name: attributes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.attribute_source AS attr,n.object_kind||':'||n.object_start||':'||n.object_end AS object,n.object_source AS object_text FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='attribute'

stages.name: calls
stages.query: SELECT n.*,f.id AS callee_id,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.text AS full_callee,coalesce(a.attr,f.text) AS callee,a.object AS receiver FROM nodes n JOIN nodes f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.id=n.function_kind||':'||n.function_start||':'||n.function_end LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.id=f.id WHERE n.kind='call'

stages.name: arguments
stages.query: SELECT n.*,c.id AS call,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY c.__path,c.id ORDER BY n.__start)-1 AS position FROM calls c JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=c.__path AND n.parent=c.arguments_kind||':'||c.arguments_start||':'||c.arguments_end WHERE n.kind NOT IN ('comment','keyword_argument','list_splat','dictionary_splat')

stages.name: keywords
stages.query: SELECT c.__path,c.id AS call,k.id AS keyword,k.__start AS keyword_start,kn.text AS name,v.id AS value,v.__start,v.__end,v.text,v.kind FROM calls c JOIN nodes k ON k.__path=c.__path AND k.parent=c.arguments_kind||':'||c.arguments_start||':'||c.arguments_end AND k.kind='keyword_argument' JOIN nodes kn ON kn.__path=k.__path AND kn.id=k.name_kind||':'||k.name_start||':'||k.name_end JOIN nodes v ON v.__path=k.__path AND v.id=k.value_kind||':'||k.value_start||':'||k.value_end

stages.name: descendants
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE walk(__path,root,node) AS (SELECT __path,id,id FROM nodes UNION SELECT w.__path,w.root,e.dst FROM walk w JOIN edges e ON e.__path=w.__path AND e.src=w.node) SELECT * FROM walk

stages.name: assignments
stages.query: SELECT n.*,l.id AS target,l.kind AS target_kind,l.text AS target_text,r.id AS value,r.kind AS expr_kind,r.text AS expr_text,o.fn FROM nodes n JOIN nodes l ON l.__path=n.__path AND l.id=n.left_kind||':'||n.left_start||':'||n.left_end LEFT JOIN nodes r ON r.__path=n.__path AND r.id=n.right_kind||':'||n.right_start||':'||n.right_end LEFT JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id WHERE n.kind='assignment'

stages.name: parameters
stages.query:
SELECT f.__path,f.id AS fn,p.id,p.kind,p.text,n.text AS name,p.type_kind||':'||p.type_start||':'||p.type_end AS annotation,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY f.__path,f.id ORDER BY p.__start)-1 AS position FROM functions f JOIN nodes p ON p.__path=f.__path AND p.parent=f.parameters_kind||':'||f.parameters_start||':'||f.parameters_end JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=p.__path AND (n.id=p.id AND p.kind='identifier' OR n.parent=p.id AND n.ordinal=0 AND n.kind='identifier')
 WHERE p.kind IN ('identifier','typed_parameter','default_parameter','typed_default_parameter')

stages.name: files
stages.query: SELECT p.__path,p.text AS source,(p.__path IN ('api/l2070_batching/executor.py','impl/common/l2070_server_plan/base_server_plan.py','impl/common/l2070_server_plan/plan_helpers.py','impl/common/l2070_server_plan/sql_backend_executor.py','l2070_batching/conditional_step.py') OR p.__path IN ('impl/common/l2070_server_plan/base_server_plan.py','impl/common/l2070_server_plan/plan_helpers.py','impl/common/l2070_server_plan/steps/tests/test_conditional_compile_dialects.py','l2070_batching/compilation.py','l2070_batching/optimizer.py','l2070_batching/plan_prerequisites.py') OR NOT rx_matches(p.__path,'(?:^|/)__init__\.py$') AND (substr(p.__path,1,36)='impl/common/l2070_server_plan/steps/' OR substr(p.__path,1,51)='impl/common/l7300_sql_versioned_transactions/steps/' OR substr(p.__path,1,40)='impl/common/l9700_sql_graph_query/steps/' OR substr(p.__path,1,41)='impl/common/l2070_server_plan/strategies/' OR rx_matches(p.__path,'^impl/common/l2070_server_plan/[^/]+$'))) AS primary_file,(NOT rx_matches(p.__path,'(?:^|/)__init__\.py$') AND (substr(p.__path,1,14)='l9750_graphql/' OR substr(p.__path,1,15)='l2080_lazy_orm/' OR substr(p.__path,1,20)='l2060_query_builder/' OR substr(p.__path,1,15)='l9900_auto_api/')) AS fallback_file,(NOT rx_matches(p.__path,'(?:^|/)__init__\.py$') AND rx_matches(p.__path,'^(?:impl|l[0-9]{4}_[^/]+)/')) AS callback_file FROM nodes p WHERE kind='module'

stages.name: import_ranges
stages.query: SELECT __path,__start,__end FROM nodes WHERE kind IN ('import_statement','import_from_statement')

stages.name: import_identifiers
stages.query: SELECT n.__path,n.id FROM import_ranges imp JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=imp.__path AND n.__start>=imp.__start AND n.__start<=imp.__end WHERE n.kind='identifier' AND n.__end<=imp.__end

stages.name: py_names
stages.query: SELECT n.* FROM nodes n JOIN nodes p ON p.__path=n.__path AND p.id=n.parent WHERE n.kind='identifier' AND NOT (p.kind IN ('function_definition','class_definition','keyword_argument') AND n.__start=p.name_start) AND NOT (p.kind='attribute' AND n.__start=p.attribute_start) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM import_identifiers imp WHERE imp.__path=n.__path AND imp.id=n.id)

stages.name: strings
stages.query: SELECT * FROM raw_strings UNION SELECT * FROM raw_fstring_parts

stages.name: branches
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.consequence_kind||':'||n.consequence_start||':'||n.consequence_end AS then_block,(SELECT min(alt.__start) FROM nodes alt WHERE alt.__path=n.__path AND alt.parent=CASE WHEN n.kind='if_statement' THEN n.id ELSE n.parent END AND alt.kind IN ('else_clause','elif_clause') AND alt.__start>n.__start) AS else_start,(SELECT max(alt.__end) FROM nodes alt WHERE alt.__path=n.__path AND alt.parent=CASE WHEN n.kind='if_statement' THEN n.id ELSE n.parent END AND alt.kind IN ('else_clause','elif_clause') AND alt.__start>n.__start) AS else_end FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind IN ('if_statement','elif_clause')

stages.name: module_string_values
stages.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT a.__path,a.target_text AS name,s.value,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY a.__path,a.target_text ORDER BY a.__start DESC) AS chosen FROM assignments a JOIN nodes expr ON expr.__path=a.__path AND expr.id=a.parent JOIN nodes root ON root.__path=expr.__path AND root.id=expr.parent AND root.kind='module' JOIN strings s ON s.__path=a.__path AND s.__start=a.right_start AND s.__end=a.right_end WHERE a.type_start IS NULL AND a.target_kind='identifier') WHERE chosen=1

stages.name: preop_functions
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE imperative(__path,name) AS (SELECT DISTINCT f.__path,f.name FROM functions f JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=f.__path AND d.root=f.id JOIN calls c ON c.__path=d.__path AND c.id=d.node WHERE c.callee IN ('_execute_compound_async','_execute_compound_sync','_run_sync','async_pre_op','build_sql_fts_components','build_sql_fts_components_async','execute_async','execute_ir','execute_ir_async','execute_sync','get_sql_fts_components','get_sql_fts_components_async','materialize_ir','pre_op','search_unversioned_scores','search_unversioned_scores_async') UNION SELECT f.__path,f.name FROM functions f JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=f.__path AND d.root=f.id JOIN calls c ON c.__path=d.__path AND c.id=d.node JOIN imperative i ON i.__path=c.__path AND i.name=c.callee) SELECT * FROM imperative

stages.name: scopes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,CASE WHEN n.kind='module' THEN NULL ELSE coalesce(parent.fn,(SELECT id FROM nodes root WHERE root.__path=n.__path AND root.kind='module' LIMIT 1)) END AS enclosing FROM nodes n LEFT JOIN ownership parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=n.edge_parent WHERE n.kind IN ('module','class_definition','function_definition')

stages.name: scope_owners
stages.query: SELECT n.__path,n.id,coalesce(CASE WHEN cls.__start>=fn.__start AND cls.__end<=fn.__end OR fn.id IS NULL THEN cls.id ELSE fn.id END,(SELECT id FROM nodes root WHERE root.__path=n.__path AND root.kind='module' LIMIT 1)) AS scope FROM nodes n JOIN ownership own ON own.__path=n.__path AND own.id=n.id LEFT JOIN nodes fn ON fn.__path=own.__path AND fn.id=own.fn LEFT JOIN nodes cls ON cls.__path=own.__path AND cls.id=own.cls

stages.name: scope_chain
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE chain(__path,scope,ancestor,depth) AS (SELECT __path,id,id,0 FROM scopes UNION ALL SELECT c.__path,c.scope,s.enclosing,c.depth+1 FROM chain c JOIN scopes s ON s.__path=c.__path AND s.id=c.ancestor WHERE s.enclosing IS NOT NULL) SELECT * FROM chain

stages.name: scope_imports
stages.query:
SELECT i.__path,o.scope,coalesce(i.alias,i.name) AS name,i.module||'.'||i.name AS origin FROM from_imports i JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=i.__path AND n.__start=i.__start AND n.__end=i.__end AND n.kind='import_from_statement' JOIN scope_owners o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id
 UNION SELECT i.__path,o.scope,coalesce(i.alias,rx_extract(i.name,'^[^.]+',0)),CASE WHEN i.alias IS NULL THEN rx_extract(i.name,'^[^.]+',0) ELSE i.name END FROM direct_imports i JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=i.__path AND n.__start=i.__start AND n.__end=i.__end AND n.kind='import_statement' JOIN scope_owners o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id

stages.name: scope_shadows
stages.query:
WITH bindings AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT *,CASE WHEN kind='delete_statement' THEN id WHEN kind='named_expression' THEN name_kind||':'||name_start||':'||name_end ELSE left_kind||':'||left_start||':'||left_end END AS target_root FROM nodes WHERE kind IN ('assignment','augmented_assignment','delete_statement','for_statement','for_in_clause','named_expression')), declarations AS MATERIALIZED (SELECT * FROM nodes WHERE kind IN ('global_statement','nonlocal_statement')) SELECT DISTINCT n.__path,o.scope,name.text AS name FROM bindings n CROSS JOIN scope_owners o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id CROSS JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=n.__path AND d.root=n.target_root CROSS JOIN py_names name ON name.__path=d.__path AND name.id=d.node
 UNION SELECT p.__path,p.fn,p.name FROM parameters p
 UNION SELECT n.__path,o.scope,n.name_source FROM nodes n JOIN scope_owners o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.parent WHERE n.kind IN ('class_definition','function_definition')
 UNION SELECT s.__path,s.id,name.text FROM declarations n CROSS JOIN scopes s ON n.__path=s.__path AND n.__start>=s.__start AND n.__end<=s.__end JOIN nodes name ON name.__path=n.__path AND name.parent=n.id AND name.kind='identifier' WHERE (s.kind='module' AND n.kind='global_statement') OR (s.kind='function_definition' AND n.kind='nonlocal_statement')

stages.name: annotations
stages.query: SELECT n.*,o.scope,s.kind='function_definition' AS function_local FROM assignments n JOIN scope_owners o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id JOIN scopes s ON s.__path=o.__path AND s.id=o.scope WHERE n.type_start IS NOT NULL AND n.target_kind='identifier'

stages.name: annotation_atoms
stages.query:
SELECT a.__path,a.id AS annotation,a.scope,n.id AS atom_id,n.__start AS atom_start,n.__end AS atom_end,n.text AS atom FROM annotations a JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=a.__path AND d.root=a.type_kind||':'||a.type_start||':'||a.type_end JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=d.__path AND n.id=d.node WHERE n.kind='identifier' AND n.parent_kind!='attribute'
 UNION SELECT a.__path,a.id,a.scope,n.id,n.__start,n.__end,CASE WHEN rx_matches(n.text,'^[A-Za-z_]\w*(?:\s*\.\s*[A-Za-z_]\w*)*$') THEN rx_replace(n.text,'\s+','') ELSE n.attr END FROM annotations a JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=a.__path AND d.root=a.type_kind||':'||a.type_start||':'||a.type_end JOIN attributes n ON n.__path=d.__path AND n.id=d.node WHERE n.parent_kind!='attribute' OR NOT rx_matches(n.text,'^[A-Za-z_]\w*(?:\s*\.\s*[A-Za-z_]\w*)*$')
 UNION SELECT a.__path,a.id,a.scope,'quoted:'||q.__start||':'||q.atom,q.__start,q.__end,q.atom FROM quoted_atoms q JOIN annotations a ON a.__path=q.__path AND a.__start=q.ann_start AND a.__end=q.ann_end

stages.name: atom_imports
stages.query: SELECT a.*,i.origin,c.depth,NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM scope_chain shadow_chain JOIN scope_shadows shadow ON shadow.__path=shadow_chain.__path AND shadow.scope=shadow_chain.ancestor AND shadow.name=i.name WHERE shadow_chain.__path=a.__path AND shadow_chain.scope=a.scope AND shadow_chain.depth<=c.depth) AS unshadowed FROM annotation_atoms a JOIN scope_chain c ON c.__path=a.__path AND c.scope=a.scope JOIN scope_imports i ON i.__path=c.__path AND i.scope=c.ancestor AND i.name=rx_extract(a.atom,'^[A-Za-z_]\w*',0) WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM scope_chain near JOIN scope_imports local ON local.__path=near.__path AND local.scope=near.ancestor AND local.name=i.name WHERE near.__path=a.__path AND near.scope=a.scope AND near.depth<c.depth)

stages.name: resolved_atoms
stages.query:
SELECT a.__path,a.annotation,a.atom_id,a.atom_start,a.atom_end,a.atom,i.origin||substr(a.atom,length(rx_extract(a.atom,'^[A-Za-z_]\w*',0))+1) AS origin,i.unshadowed AND (SELECT count(DISTINCT x.origin) FROM atom_imports x WHERE x.__path=i.__path AND x.annotation=i.annotation AND x.atom_id=i.atom_id)=1 AS trusted FROM annotation_atoms a JOIN atom_imports i ON i.__path=a.__path AND i.annotation=a.annotation AND i.atom_id=a.atom_id
 UNION SELECT a.__path,a.annotation,a.atom_id,a.atom_start,a.atom_end,a.atom,a.atom,0 FROM annotation_atoms a WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM atom_imports i WHERE i.__path=a.__path AND i.annotation=a.annotation AND i.atom_id=a.atom_id)

stages.name: ignored_annotation_metadata
stages.query:
SELECT DISTINCT a.__path,a.annotation,a.atom_id FROM resolved_atoms a JOIN annotations field ON field.__path=a.__path AND field.id=a.annotation JOIN nodes generic ON generic.__path=a.__path AND generic.kind='generic_type' AND generic.__start>=field.type_start AND generic.__end<=field.type_end
 JOIN nodes base ON base.__path=generic.__path AND base.parent=generic.id AND base.ordinal=0 JOIN resolved_atoms imported ON imported.__path=base.__path AND imported.atom_id=base.id AND imported.annotation=field.id AND imported.trusted AND imported.origin IN ('typing.Literal','typing_extensions.Literal','typing.Annotated','typing_extensions.Annotated')
 JOIN nodes params ON params.__path=generic.__path AND params.parent=generic.id AND params.kind='type_parameter' JOIN nodes arg ON arg.__path=params.__path AND arg.parent=params.id
 WHERE a.atom_start>=arg.__start AND a.atom_end<=arg.__end AND (imported.origin IN ('typing.Literal','typing_extensions.Literal') OR arg.ordinal>0)

stages.name: nodes
stages.query:
SELECT *,kind||':'||__start||':'||__end AS id,
 parent_kind||':'||parent_start||':'||parent_end AS parent,
 ancestor_kind||':'||ancestor_start||':'||ancestor_end AS edge_parent,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY __path,parent_start,parent_end,parent_kind ORDER BY __start,__end,kind)-1 AS ordinal
 FROM (SELECT * FROM syntax_rows_0 UNION ALL SELECT * FROM syntax_rows_1)

stages.name: edges
stages.query: SELECT __path,edge_parent AS src,id AS dst,ordinal FROM nodes WHERE edge_parent IS NOT NULL

stages.name: functions
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='function_definition'

stages.name: ownership
stages.query:
WITH RECURSIVE owned(__path,id,fn,cls,top_fn) AS (
 SELECT n.__path,n.id,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='class_definition' THEN n.id END,CASE WHEN n.kind='function_definition' THEN n.id END FROM nodes n
 LEFT JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=n.edge_parent WHERE parent.id IS NULL
 UNION ALL SELECT child.__path,child.id,CASE WHEN child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.fn END,CASE WHEN child.kind='class_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.cls END,CASE WHEN owned.top_fn IS NULL AND child.kind='function_definition' THEN child.id ELSE owned.top_fn END
 FROM owned JOIN edges e ON e.__path=owned.__path AND e.src=owned.id
 JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=e.__path AND child.id=e.dst) SELECT * FROM owned

stages.name: classes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.name_source AS name FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='class_definition'

stages.name: attributes
stages.query: SELECT n.*,n.attribute_source AS attr,n.object_kind||':'||n.object_start||':'||n.object_end AS object,n.object_source AS object_text FROM nodes n WHERE n.kind='attribute'

stages.name: calls
stages.query: SELECT n.*,f.id AS callee_id,f.kind AS callee_kind,f.text AS full_callee,coalesce(a.attr,f.text) AS callee,a.object AS receiver FROM nodes n JOIN nodes f ON f.__path=n.__path AND f.id=n.function_kind||':'||n.function_start||':'||n.function_end LEFT JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=f.__path AND a.id=f.id WHERE n.kind='call'

stages.name: descendants
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE roots(__path,id) AS (SELECT __path,id FROM nodes WHERE kind='type' OR kind='assignment' AND type_start IS NOT NULL OR kind='function_definition' AND (name_source='require_sql_physical_conditional' OR name_source='compile_sql_conditional_step' OR name_source='compile' AND rx_matches(__path,'(?:^|/)l2070_batching/conditional_step\.py$')) UNION SELECT __path,left_kind||':'||left_start||':'||left_end FROM nodes WHERE kind IN ('assignment','for_statement') UNION SELECT __path,condition_kind||':'||condition_start||':'||condition_end FROM nodes WHERE kind IN ('if_statement','elif_clause') UNION SELECT __path,subject_kind||':'||subject_start||':'||subject_end FROM nodes WHERE kind='match_statement' UNION SELECT child.__path,child.id FROM nodes parent JOIN nodes child ON child.__path=parent.__path AND child.parent=parent.id AND child.ordinal=1 WHERE parent.kind='conditional_expression'), walk(__path,root,node) AS (SELECT __path,id,id FROM roots UNION SELECT w.__path,w.root,e.dst FROM walk w JOIN edges e ON e.__path=w.__path AND e.src=w.node) SELECT * FROM walk

stages.name: returns
stages.query: SELECT n.*,v.id AS value,v.kind AS expr_kind,v.text AS expr_text,o.fn FROM nodes n JOIN nodes v ON v.__path=n.__path AND v.parent=n.id LEFT JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id WHERE n.kind='return_statement'

stages.name: assignments
stages.query: SELECT n.*,l.id AS target,l.kind AS target_kind,l.text AS target_text,r.id AS value,r.kind AS expr_kind,r.text AS expr_text,o.fn FROM nodes n JOIN nodes l ON l.__path=n.__path AND l.id=n.left_kind||':'||n.left_start||':'||n.left_end LEFT JOIN nodes r ON r.__path=n.__path AND r.id=n.right_kind||':'||n.right_start||':'||n.right_end LEFT JOIN ownership o ON o.__path=n.__path AND o.id=n.id WHERE n.kind IN ('assignment','augmented_assignment')

stages.name: parameters
stages.query:
SELECT f.__path,f.id AS fn,p.id,p.kind,p.text,n.text AS name,p.type_kind||':'||p.type_start||':'||p.type_end AS annotation,
 row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY f.__path,f.id ORDER BY p.__start)-1 AS position FROM functions f JOIN nodes p ON p.__path=f.__path AND p.parent=f.parameters_kind||':'||f.parameters_start||':'||f.parameters_end JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=p.__path AND (n.id=p.id AND p.kind='identifier' OR n.parent=p.id AND n.ordinal=0 AND n.kind='identifier')
 WHERE p.kind IN ('identifier','typed_parameter','default_parameter','typed_default_parameter')

stages.name: module_names
stages.query: SELECT __path,replace(rx_extract(__path,'(?:^|/)((?:impl|l2070_batching|scripts)/.*)\.py$',1),'/','.') AS qualified FROM nodes WHERE kind='module' AND rx_matches(__path,'(?:^|/)(?:impl|l2070_batching|scripts)/') UNION SELECT __path,rx_extract(__path,'(?:^|/)([^/]+)\.py$',1) FROM nodes WHERE kind='module' AND NOT rx_matches(__path,'(?:^|/)(?:impl|l2070_batching|scripts)/')

stages.name: aliases
stages.query: SELECT n.__path,n.__start,CASE WHEN n.kind='aliased_import' THEN n.alias_source WHEN parent.kind='import_statement' THEN rx_extract(n.text,'^([\w]+)',1) ELSE n.text END AS local,CASE WHEN parent.kind='import_from_statement' THEN trim(parent.module_name_source,'.')||'.'||CASE WHEN n.kind='aliased_import' THEN n.name_source ELSE n.text END ELSE CASE WHEN n.kind='aliased_import' THEN n.name_source ELSE n.text END END AS origin FROM nodes n JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=n.parent WHERE parent.kind IN ('import_statement','import_from_statement') AND n.kind IN ('dotted_name','aliased_import') AND n.__start!=coalesce(parent.module_name_start,-1)

stages.name: conditional_classes
stages.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT c.*,module.qualified||'.'||c.name AS qualified_name,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY c.__path,c.name ORDER BY c.__start DESC) AS chosen FROM classes c JOIN module_names module ON module.__path=c.__path) WHERE chosen=1

stages.name: class_bases
stages.query: SELECT c.__path,c.id AS cls,coalesce((SELECT alias.origin FROM aliases alias WHERE alias.__path=c.__path AND alias.local=rx_extract(b.text,'^([\w]+)',1) AND alias.__start<c.__start ORDER BY alias.__start DESC LIMIT 1),rx_extract(b.text,'^([\w]+)',1))||coalesce(rx_extract(b.text,'^[\w]+((?:\.[\w]+)*)',1),'') AS name FROM conditional_classes c JOIN nodes arg ON arg.__path=c.__path AND arg.parent=c.id AND arg.kind='argument_list' JOIN nodes b ON b.__path=arg.__path AND b.parent=arg.id WHERE b.kind IN ('identifier','attribute','call')

stages.name: derived_conditionals
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE derived(name) AS (SELECT 'l2070_batching.conditional_step.ConditionalStep' UNION SELECT c.qualified_name FROM conditional_classes c JOIN class_bases b ON b.__path=c.__path AND b.cls=c.id JOIN derived d ON d.name=b.name) SELECT * FROM derived

stages.name: conditional_methods
stages.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT f.*,c.id AS cls,c.name AS class_name,c.qualified_name,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY c.__path,c.id,f.name ORDER BY f.__start DESC) AS chosen FROM functions f JOIN ownership own ON own.__path=f.__path AND own.id=f.id JOIN conditional_classes c ON c.__path=f.__path AND c.id=own.cls) WHERE chosen=1

stages.name: conditional_functions
stages.query: SELECT * FROM (SELECT f.*,module.qualified||'.'||f.name AS qualified_name,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY f.__path,f.name ORDER BY f.__start DESC) AS chosen FROM functions f JOIN ownership own ON own.__path=f.__path AND own.id=f.id JOIN module_names module ON module.__path=f.__path WHERE own.cls IS NULL) WHERE chosen=1

stages.name: function_colors
stages.query: SELECT f.__path,f.id,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants d JOIN nodes a ON a.__path=d.__path AND a.id=d.node WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.root=f.id AND a.kind='identifier' AND a.text='BackendType') OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants d JOIN attributes a ON a.__path=d.__path AND a.id=d.node WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.root=f.id AND a.attr IN ('backend_type','is_sql_backend','dialect')) AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants d JOIN nodes branch ON branch.__path=d.__path AND branch.id=d.node WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.root=f.id AND branch.kind IN ('if_statement','elif_clause','conditional_expression','match_statement')) AS backend_selection,EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM descendants d JOIN nodes raised ON raised.__path=d.__path AND raised.id=d.node WHERE d.__path=f.__path AND d.root=f.id AND raised.kind='raise_statement' AND rx_matches(raised.text,'^raise\s+TypeError(?:\s*\(|\s*$)')) AS raises_type_error FROM functions f WHERE f.name='require_sql_physical_conditional' OR f.name='compile_sql_conditional_step' OR f.name='compile' AND rx_matches(f.__path,'(?:^|/)l2070_batching/conditional_step\.py$')

stages.name: contract_blocks
stages.query: SELECT n.*,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY n.__path ORDER BY n.__end-n.__start,n.__start) AS sequence FROM nodes n JOIN ownership own ON own.__path=n.__path AND own.id=n.id JOIN conditional_methods m ON m.__path=own.__path AND m.id=own.fn WHERE n.kind='block' AND m.name='require_sql_physical_conditional'

stages.name: callable_names
stages.query: SELECT n.* FROM nodes n LEFT JOIN nodes parent ON parent.__path=n.__path AND parent.id=n.parent WHERE n.kind='identifier' AND n.text='Callable' AND NOT (parent.kind='attribute' AND parent.attribute_start=n.__start) AND NOT (parent.kind IN ('keyword_argument','function_definition','class_definition') AND parent.name_start=n.__start) AND parent.kind NOT IN ('parameters','lambda_parameters','list_splat_pattern','dictionary_splat_pattern')

stages.name: callable_parameters
stages.query: SELECT DISTINCT p.__path,p.fn,p.name FROM parameters p JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=p.__path AND d.root=p.annotation JOIN callable_names atom ON atom.__path=d.__path AND atom.id=d.node

stages.name: block_results
stages.query: WITH RECURSIVE fold(__path,sequence,state) AS (SELECT DISTINCT __path,0,'{}' FROM contract_blocks UNION ALL SELECT b.__path,b.sequence,substr(fold.state,1,length(fold.state)-1)||CASE WHEN length(fold.state)>2 THEN ',' ELSE '' END||json_quote(b.id)||':'||CAST((EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes stmt WHERE stmt.__path=b.__path AND stmt.parent=b.id AND stmt.__start<=coalesce((SELECT min(barrier.__start) FROM nodes barrier WHERE barrier.__path=b.__path AND barrier.parent=b.id AND barrier.kind IN ('raise_statement','return_statement')),b.__end) AND (stmt.kind='raise_statement' AND rx_matches(stmt.text,'^raise\s+TypeError(?:\s*\(|\s*$)') OR stmt.kind='if_statement' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes alternative WHERE alternative.__path=stmt.__path AND alternative.parent=stmt.id AND alternative.kind='else_clause') AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM contract_blocks child WHERE child.__path=stmt.__path AND (child.parent=stmt.id OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes arm WHERE arm.__path=child.__path AND arm.id=child.parent AND arm.parent=stmt.id AND arm.kind IN ('elif_clause','else_clause'))) AND coalesce(json_extract(fold.state,'$."'||child.id||'"'),0)!=1) OR stmt.kind='match_statement' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM nodes arm WHERE arm.__path=stmt.__path AND arm.kind='case_clause' AND arm.__start>stmt.__start AND arm.__end<=stmt.__end) AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM contract_blocks child JOIN nodes arm ON arm.__path=child.__path AND arm.id=child.parent AND arm.kind='case_clause' WHERE arm.__path=stmt.__path AND arm.__start>stmt.__start AND arm.__end<=stmt.__end AND coalesce(json_extract(fold.state,'$."'||child.id||'"'),0)!=1)))) AS TEXT)||'}' FROM fold JOIN contract_blocks b ON b.__path=fold.__path AND b.sequence=fold.sequence+1) SELECT __path,state FROM fold WHERE sequence=(SELECT max(b.sequence) FROM contract_blocks b WHERE b.__path=fold.__path)

stages.name: always_raises
stages.query: SELECT m.__path,m.id FROM conditional_methods m JOIN block_results b ON b.__path=m.__path WHERE m.name='require_sql_physical_conditional' AND json_extract(b.state,'$."'||m.body_kind||':'||m.body_start||':'||m.body_end||'"')=1

stages.name: integer_returns
stages.query: SELECT m.__path,m.cls,m.name,n.kind,n.text,row_number() OVER(PARTITION BY m.__path,m.cls,m.name ORDER BY n.__start) AS ordinal FROM conditional_methods m JOIN returns r ON r.__path=m.__path AND r.__start>=m.__start AND r.__end<=m.__end JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=r.__path AND n.id=r.value AND n.kind IN ('integer','true','false')

stages.name: branch_variables
stages.query: SELECT a.__path,m.id AS fn,name.text AS name,a.__start FROM conditional_methods m JOIN assignments a ON a.__path=m.__path AND a.__start>=m.__start AND a.__end<=m.__end JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=a.__path AND d.root=a.target JOIN nodes name ON name.__path=d.__path AND name.id=d.node AND name.kind='identifier' WHERE rx_matches(a.expr_text,'then_plan\.steps|else_plan\.steps|conditional_branch_steps|then_steps|else_steps') AND a.expr_kind IN ('identifier','attribute','call') UNION SELECT n.__path,m.id,name.text,n.__start FROM conditional_methods m JOIN nodes n ON n.__path=m.__path AND n.kind='for_statement' AND n.__start>=m.__start AND n.__end<=m.__end JOIN descendants d ON d.__path=n.__path AND d.root=n.left_kind||':'||n.left_start||':'||n.left_end JOIN nodes name ON name.__path=d.__path AND name.id=d.node AND name.kind='identifier' WHERE rx_matches(n.right_source,'then_plan\.steps|else_plan\.steps|conditional_branch_steps|then_steps|else_steps')

stages.name: self_stores
stages.query: SELECT a.*,attr.attr,m.cls,m.name AS method,m.id AS method_id,1 AS occurrence FROM assignments a JOIN attributes attr ON attr.__path=a.__path AND attr.id=a.target AND attr.object_text='self' JOIN ownership own ON own.__path=a.__path AND own.id=a.id JOIN conditional_methods m ON m.__path=own.__path AND m.id=own.fn
